# SoyStories Yakuin, Fukuoka (グルテンフリー＆100％植物性スイーツ Soy Stories 薬院店)

> SoyStories is a 100% gluten-free and 100% plant-based (vegan) sweets café in Yakuin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka, Japan. Every sweet and drink is crafted without wheat, dairy, eggs, honey, gelatin, or refined white sugar.

## Key Store Information
- **Official English Website**: https://en.soystories.cafe/
- **Korean Guide**: https://en.soystories.cafe/ko.html
- **Traditional Chinese Guide**: https://en.soystories.cafe/zh-tw.html
- **Japanese Guide (this site)**: https://en.soystories.cafe/ja.html
- **Japanese Store Website**: https://soystories.jp/
- **Opening Hours**: Open daily 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM (22:00), Last Order 9:45 PM (21:45). No regular holidays (check Instagram `@soystories_yakuin` for special hours).
- **Address (English)**: Chisan Mansion Dai-3 Hakata 1F, 2-2-24 Yakuin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka 810-0022, Japan
- **Address (Japanese / Taxi Card)**: 〒810-0022 福岡県福岡市中央区薬院2丁目2-24 チサンマンション第3博多 1F SoyStories 薬院店
- **Nearest Station**: 2–3 min walk (~160m) from Yakuin-odori Station (薬院大通駅), Exit 2, on the Fukuoka City Subway Nanakuma Line (~4 min subway ride from Tenjin-minami Station; ~9 min subway ride from Hakata Station).
- **Phone**: +81-92-231-0677 (092-231-0677)
- **Seating & Facilities**: Compact dine-in space (4 main seats + wooden cube stools) and full takeaway. Strollers and suitcases welcome; no minimum order; sharing welcome.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash (JPY), Visa, Mastercard, JCB, American Express, Diners Club, Suica, PASMO, ICOCA, SUGOCA, nimoca, Hayakaken, iD, QUICPay, PayPay. All prices include tax.

## Kitchen & Allergen Policy
- **Never brought into the kitchen**: Wheat / gluten (including staff personal meals for wheat), dairy, eggs, meat, fish, honey, gelatin, refined white sugar.
- **Handled in the same kitchen**: Soybeans, almonds, sesame, Japanese yam (yamaimo), apples, peaches, and oranges (and certain seasonal/delivery items such as vegan tiramisu may use cashew nuts).
- **Cross-contact notice**: While strict hygiene and equipment care are practiced, complete elimination of trace cross-contact cannot be guaranteed. Guests with severe allergies or celiac disease should review per-item ingredients and consult staff before ordering.
- **Official Allergy Disclosure (FoodHug)**: https://food-hug.com/soystoriesenglish-page/
